name: Aradesh, the Founder
oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
Whenever a creature you control attacks, if it enlisted a creature this combat, the creature that attacked gains double strike until end of turn. If that creature's power is 4 or greater, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)

Whenever a creature you control attacks, if it enlisted a creature this combat, the creature that attacked gains double strike until end of turn. If that creature's power is 4 or greater, draw a card.

needs.what: the Enlist keyword (702.154): as the creature is declared as an attacker, its controller may tap a nonattacking, untapped creature they control without summoning sickness; when they do, a reflexive trigger adds the tapped creature's power to the attacker's until end of turn, and the engine records that the attacker enlisted a creature this combat
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Enlist is not in keywords; the closest are a tap_permanents cost with `as` (an activated ability, not an optional choice made during attack declaration) and an `attacks` trigger with a may/pump, which would happen after attack declaration rather than as an attack-declaration cost and cannot exclude creatures that are attacking

needs.what: a trigger condition 'the attacking creature enlisted a creature this combat' readable on an `attacks` trigger whose subject is any creature you control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: condition_keys has has_flag/has_turn_flag but nothing sets a per-combat enlisted flag, since no enlist mechanism exists
